syntax: App/helper/new regression and settings/status/EV inline scripts passed; relevant JSON validated
homeyBuild: CLI 4.6.2 debug validation and build passed

updates.peakGuard: Existing result/status publication withdraws net-room advice immediately. Existing widget event updates the displayed circle to red without another API call, rerender, listener or timer. Repeated interventions restart the recovery interval. Missing grid/phase feedback cannot prove recovery.
updates.recovery: A full 60 seconds after the first clear result, checked via existing minute heartbeat/WAF refresh. Resume only if cached cheap-period eligibility and the current normalized Saving battery status still apply.
updates.staleResponses: An older in-flight status response cannot overwrite a newer blocked push; timestamp-based revisions distinguish fresh snapshots after an app restart.
updates.wafSettings: EMS > WAF-widget: WAF colours enabled plus separate ordered red/orange/green points. Defaults: energy reserve -4 / 1 / 7 kWh; grid room 0 / 1000 / 2000 W. Invalid order is rejected; old missing settings receive defaults. The existing widget colour switch still applies.
updates.separateValues: Original energy budget and Flow tags retain kWh. Grid room remains a separate widget/API value in W; no Flow card/tag added.
updates.resources: Nine small presentation preferences, one bounded snapshot and one four-scalar guard latch. No history, polling, timers, new listeners or periodic settings writes. 100,000 idle guard observations took 4.6 ms on the test host and allocated no guard runtime; not a Homey hardware benchmark.

scope.unchanged: All controller libraries apart from waf-presentation.js, existing Flow cards/tokens and Athom website descriptions are byte-identical to the delivered 1.2.40. Forty controller snapshots and 33 battery publications, phase/Peak Guard statuses and original energy budgets matched exactly.
scope.eventReuse: Existing status widget subscription carries WAF-only updates. Existing EV widget callback ignores this payload to avoid an extra EV refresh.

visual.performed: Five-language DOM configuration/validation/save tests; widget push and stale-response simulation; no added interval or subscription; red hold and separate colour-scale anchors verified.
visual.notPerformed: No real Homey/gsm rendered visual checks or physical hardware tests.

skipped: Full independent HVAC, EV controller, boiler, battery, AutoTune, PV and Hybrid regression suites; their control modules were unchanged. No full suite requested.
